title: Unsatz: Evaluating Scientific Discovery Without a Given Ansatz
abstract: arXiv:2611.03713v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Before a scientist fits any parameter, they must decide what the model contains: which quantities exist, which are hidden, how they interact, and how they are measured. Physicists call such a trial form an ansatz. Benchmarks for automated equation discovery mostly supply it, by fixing the variables, a library of candidate terms, or a law to be modified. We introduce Unsatz, a benchmark in which an LLM agent must construct the ansatz itself. Each task is a simulated system, generated from a private seed as a program in a small modeling language: ordinary, delay, or partial differential equations, discrete maps, static and causal models, or stochastic processes, possibly with latent states, distorted sensors, and uninformative measurement channels. translated_title: Unsat​z：在没有给定拟设的情况下评估科学发现
translated_abstract: 在科学家拟合任何参数之前，他们必须先决定模型中包含什么：哪些量存在、哪些量是隐藏的、它们如何相互作用，以及如何被测量。物理学家将这种尝试性的模型形式称为“拟设”。现有的自动化方程发现基准测试大多直接提供了拟设——通过固定变量、给定候选项库，或提供待修改的定律。我们提出了 Unsat​z，一个要求 LLM 智能体自行构建拟设的基准测试。每个任务都是一个由私有种子生成的模拟系统，以一个小型建模语言编写成的程序形式呈现：可以是常微分方程、时滞微分方程或偏微分方程、离散映射、静态与因果模型，或随机过程，其中可能包含潜在状态、失真的传感器以及无信息量的测量通道。智能体需要在预算内购买实验，用同一建模语言编写候选程序，从基准测试提供的拟合器中获得系数，并仅根据其最终程序……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了 Unsat​z 基准，首次要求 LLM 智能体在没有给定模型形式（拟设）的情况下自主构建拟设——在有限预算内设计实验并用统一建模语言编写候选模型程序——从而更真实、更完整地评估人工智能的科学发现能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Unsat​z, a benchmark that for the first time requires LLM agents to construct the ansatz themselves—buying experiments within a budget and writing candidate model programs in a unified modeling language—thereby evaluating scientific discovery without any given model structure.
